turns.q: Can I trust Supertech as a builder? What happened with their delayed projects?
turns.answer:
No. Supertech Limited carries an active **NCLT Insolvency** legal flag, and fresh primary market bookings or investments with this developer must be strictly avoided. 

The developer's downfall stems from aggressive over-leveraging, financial mismanagement, and severe regulatory non-compliance across NCR:

* **Insolvency Proceedings (NCLT):** In March 2022, the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) admitted Supertech Limited into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) following defaults on institutional loans. An Interim Resolution Professional (IRP) was appointed to manage operations and project completion under court supervision.
* **The Apex Twin Towers Demolition:** The most prominent project setback occurred in August 2022, when Supertech's 40-storey Apex and Ceyane towers in Emerald Court (Sector 93A, Noida) were demolished by order of the Supreme Court of India due to illegal construction in violation of building norms and safety distances.
* **Widespread Delivery Delays:** Multiple flagship projects—including Supertech Supernova (Sector 94), North Eye (Sector 74), and the Eco Village townships across Greater Noida West—suffered multi-year delays caused by cash flow diversion, unpaid land dues owed to local development authorities, and stalled registry processes.

While interim project-wise resolution mechanisms (such as project-specific CIRP) continue under judicial oversight to hand over ready units to existing buyers, no fresh purchases should be considered with this developer.

turns.q: For a 1.4 crore flat in Noida, what is the total cost including stamp duty, registration and GST?
turns.answer:
### On ₹1.40 Cr

| Charge | Amount |
| :--- | ---: |
| Stamp duty (7%) | **₹9,80,000** |
| Stamp duty if a woman is primary owner (6%) | ₹8,40,000 |
| Registration (1%) | ₹1,40,000 |
| GST if under construction (5%) | ₹7,00,000 |
| GST if ready to move with OC | ₹0 |
| **Total, ready to move** | **₹1,51,20,000** |
| **Total, under construction** | **₹1,58,20,000** |

Stamp duty is charged on the agreement value or the circle rate, whichever is higher, so the figure above is the floor. You also deduct 1% TDS (₹1,40,000) from the payment to the seller and deposit it with Form 26QB.

### Statutory taxes & registration charges (Uttar Pradesh)

These are set by law and are the same for every project.

| Component | Rate | Nature | Paid when & to whom |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stamp duty** | 7% of agreement or circle value, whichever is higher | Mandatory | At registry, to the UP Stamp & Registration Department |
| **Stamp duty — female primary owner** | 6% | Concession | At registry |
| **Registration fee** | 1% of value | Mandatory | At deed execution, to the Sub-Registrar |
| **GST — under construction** | 5% (without input tax credit) | Statutory | Billed across construction milestones |
| **GST — ready to move with OC** | 0% | Exempt | Not applicable once the Occupancy Certificate is granted |
| **TDS (Section 194-IA)** | 1% of sale consideration | Mandatory | Deducted by the buyer when value exceeds ₹50 Lakh (Form 26QB) |

### Budgeting
Allow 12–14% above base price for an under-construction home, or 8–9% above base price for ready-to-move with OC, to cover statutory and possession charges — typical for Noida — not verified for this project.
